journey.title: Cooking and logging
journey.purpose: Follow one pinned revision through focused cooking mode, finish the batch, and record eating a serving as a separate action that can be corrected.

steps.intent: Open the pinned revision and scale the displayed servings if the batch needs it.
Follow one prominent step while marking completion separately from viewing.
Finish cooking to create a prepared batch from the pinned revision.
Record eating a serving as a distinct consumption event.

claims.statement: A person can cook without consuming, consume leftovers without cooking again, or close the viewer without logging anything.
Undo creates a correction and reverses linked inventory effects transactionally rather than double-applying them.
